The '''Indigo Tower''' was a restaurant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which was modeled after the famous [[Skysitter Restaurant/Legends|Skysitter Restaurant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], it was visited by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]], who was following [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in hopes of eavesdropping on them. However, they foiled his efforts by using one of the establishment's private dining rooms and leaving [[Karn Valanti]] and [[Lina Zev]] to act as their doubles as they covertly left the Indigo Tower.<ref name="Omen" />
